variants.title: V-I characteristic of a germanium point-contact diode (1N34A)
variants.unknown: the cut-in voltage and dynamic resistance of a germanium diode
variants.note: Germanium's narrower band gap gives a saturation current far larger than silicon's, so it cuts in near 0.3 V and leaks microamps in reverse. The 100 kohm reverse leakage is illustrative.

source.title: 1N34A SPICE model (Is = 0.2 uA, n = 1.3, Rs = 7 ohm)
